data.text: Technical documentation for developers working with LLM Notetaker's codebase and API endpoints.
Core API endpoints for interacting with the application:

data.code:
# Save note content (EditorJS format)
POST /api/notes/{note_id}/content
{
  "time": 1693656000000,
  "blocks": [...],
  "version": "2.29.0"
}

# Get note content
GET /api/notes/{note_id}/content

# Search notes
GET /api/search?q=query&type=note&tags=tag1,tag2

# Send chat message
POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages
{
  "message": "Hello, AI!",
  "attachments": ["file_id_1", "file_id_2"]
}

# Get chat history
GET /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages

# Upload file for RAG
POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/upload
# Form data with file

# Upload document
POST /api/files/upload
# Multipart form data

# Get file metadata
GET /api/files/{file_id}

# Download file
GET /api/files/{file_id}/download

# Delete file
DELETE /api/files/{file_id}

-- Nodes table (notes, folders, chats)
CREATE TABLE nodes (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('note', 'folder', 'chat')),
    parent_id TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Note content (EditorJS blocks)
CREATE TABLE note_contents (
    note_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- JSON
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (note_id) REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Chat messages
CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    chat_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'bot')),
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    sources TEXT, -- JSON array
    FOREIGN KEY (chat_id) REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Tags and relationships
CREATE TABLE tags (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE node_tags (
    node_id TEXT,
    tag_id TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (node_id, tag_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (node_id) REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- File uploads
CREATE TABLE uploaded_files (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    filename TEXT NOT NULL,
    original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_size INTEGER,
    mime_type TEXT,
    chat_id TEXT,
    uploaded_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (chat_id) REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

# Required environment variables
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here

# Optional configuration
FLASK_ENV=development  # or production
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///instance/notetaker.db
UPLOAD_FOLDER=data/uploads
CHROMA_PERSIST_DIRECTORY=data/chroma_db
MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=16777216  # 16MB file upload limit

# AI model settings
DEFAULT_MODEL=gpt-4
EMBEDDING_MODEL=text-embedding-ada-002
MAX_TOKENS=4000
TEMPERATURE=0.7

# Run unit tests
python -m pytest tests/

# Run with coverage
python -m pytest --cov=. tests/

# Test specific module
python -m pytest tests/test_database.py

# Run integration tests
python -m pytest tests/integration/

# Example Docker deployment
FROM python:3.11-slim

WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt

COPY . .
EXPOSE 5000

CMD ["gunicorn", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:5000", "app:app"]

data.text: Always test thoroughly in a staging environment before deploying to production. The AI integration requires careful API key management and rate limiting.
